name: Dinajpur
admin_post1947: Split by Partition -- Dinajpur District, Bangladesh, and Uttar/Dakshin Dinajpur, West Bengal, India
note: Where the Tebhaga movement's first direct actions began, in the Thakurgaon subdivision.

name: Kakdwip
admin_post1947: South 24 Parganas district, West Bengal, India
note: One of the movement's southern storm centres, along with Namkhana.

name: Nachole
admin_pre1947: Rajshahi District, Bengal Presidency, British India
admin_post1947: Nachole Upazila, Chapainawabganj District, East Bengal/Pakistan (1947-71), then Bangladesh
note: Site of the January 1950 uprising led by Ila Mitra, the Tebhaga movement's continuation after Partition.
